chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:
The one who is created from soil is buried in it.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran and Hadith say about humans being created from soil and returning to it?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi underscores the theological concept of 'Jasad' (physical body) returning to its elemental origin, a theme deeply rooted in Shia eschatology regarding bodily resurrection. It serves as a reminder of human humility and the transient nature of worldly life, reinforcing the belief that death is merely a return to the dust from which Adam was created. This narration is often cited in discussions on the continuity of the physical self in the afterlife.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘
The one who is Created from the soil, is buried in it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “One of the two Imam, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ’
From whatever soil one is created in that soil one is buried also.’”
